statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Endpoints MUST ignore feature negotiation options that do not arrive in strictly-increasing order by Sequence Number.

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Change options generated within the CHANGING state are retransmissions and MUST have exactly the same contents as previously transmitted options, allowing tolerance for reordering.
statements.trigger: generating Change option within CHANGING state
actions: set Change option contents identical to previously transmitted Change option

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If a packet's Sequence Number is less than or equal to FGSR, then its Change options MUST be ignored.
statements.trigger: receipt of packet containing Change options
actions: ignore Change options in received packet

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If a packet's Sequence Number is less than or equal to FGSR, if it has no Acknowledgement Number, OR if its Acknowledgement Number is less than FGSS, then its Confirm options MUST be ignored.
statements.trigger: receipt of packet containing Confirm options
actions: ignore Confirm options in received packet

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Alternatively, an endpoint MAY maintain separate FGSR and FGSS values for every feature.

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Either algorithm MAY be used; the first algorithm, with connection-wide FGSR and FGSS variables, is RECOMMENDED.
